verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerts docs say any signal can be evaluated against a threshold or for abnormal behavior, and that notifications route issues to the correct system or team. NRQL-based alerts are described as the primary alert type. The evidence does not mention grouping of alerts or incidents, or silencing and muting of notifications, so only about half the story is supported. missing for 10: alert/incident grouping, notification silencing or muting, independent or hands-on corroboration of routing depth

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: Configure any signal to be evaluated against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior.
Route issues to the correct system or team using notifications.
You define the data to watch, the thresholds that if exceeded mean an issue, who is notified, and how.
Set up NRQL-based alerts (our primary and most powerful type of alert)
